meanings: to infringe on, to encroach on, to violate, to assault
Qing (Wade-Giles: Ch'ing) dynasty of imperial China (1644-1911), surname Qing, (of water etc) clear; clean, quiet; still, pure; uncorrupted, clear; distinct, to clear; to settle (accounts)
Qingming or Pure Brightness Festival or Tomb Sweeping Day, celebration for the dead (in early April)
